2608.26978.title: Terrain signatures in Welsh settlement names
2608.26978.paper_summary: Landscapes are named, but whether names retain measurable environmental information beyond broad geographic structure is rarely tested. We analysed 3,757 Welsh settlements using a frozen, source-audited 24-element lexical framework, preregistered outcome-specific models and geographically structured validation. The central comparison contrasted 101 settlements carrying high-terrain elements (\textit{bryn} or \textit{mynydd}) with 139 carrying low-terrain elements (\textit{cwm} or \textit{pant}). High-terrain names occupied locations 24.4 m higher relative to their 2-km surroundings (95\% CI, 10.8--38.1 m; Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.00137). The association remained positive across prespecified 1-, 2- and 5-km neighbourhood definitions and was reproduced using an independently produced elevation source (24.1 m; 95\% CI, 10.6--37.6 m). Adding terrain-name polarity to a non-lexical spatial and settlement baseline reduced geographically held-out mean squared error by 4.63\%, 6.22\% and 7.30\% under 10-, 25- and 50-km spatial blocking, respectively, although improvement varied among held-out regions. River-related names provided weaker, directionally consistent evidence, while the preregistered woodland model was non-estimable. Residual spatial structure, unresolved name language and the absence of independent external replication limit interpretation. Selected Welsh settlement-name categories therefore retain measurable information about present-day terrain within Wales, without establishing individual etymology, causal naming, historical environmental memory or transferability to other naming systems.
2608.26978.paper_summary_zh: 地形被命名，但這些名稱是否保留超越廣泛地理結構的可測量環境信息卻很少被檢驗。<lb/>我們使用一個凍結的、來源審核的24元素詞彙框架，分析了3,757個威爾士定居點，並預註冊了特定結果模型和地理結構驗證。<lb/>核心比較對比了101個承載高地形元素（\textit{bryn}或\textit{mynydd}）的定居點與139個承載低地形元素（\textit{cwm}或\textit{pant}）的定居點。<lb/>高地形名稱所佔據的位置相對於其2公里周圍環境高出24.4米（95\% CI，10.8--38.1米；Holm調整後$p$ = 0.00137）。<lb/>在預先指定的1公里、2公里和5公里鄰域定義中，這種關聯仍然是正向的，並且使用獨立生成的海拔來源重現（24.1米；95\% CI，10.6--37.6米）。<lb/>將地形名稱極性添加到非詞彙的空間和定居基線中，分別在10公里、25公里和50公里的空間阻塞下，減少了地理保留的均方誤差4.63\%、6.22\%和7.30\%，儘管改進在保留區域之間有所不同。<lb/>與河流相關的名稱提供了較弱且方向一致的證據，而預註冊的林地模型則無法估計。<lb/>殘餘的空間結構、未解決的名稱語言以及缺乏獨立的外部重複驗證限制了詮釋。<lb/>因此，選定的威爾士定居點名稱類別保留了有關威爾士當前地形的可測量信息，但並未確立個別的詞源、因果命名、歷史環境記憶或向其他命名系統的可轉移性。
